rationale: The agent properly verified the user via full name and zip code, matched to a single account, before accessing order details. It reviewed the orders using read tools, confirmed the exact address change for both pending orders, obtained explicit user confirmation, and then executed the updates correctly. The agent then checked the jigsaw’s status (consistent with the latest tool results showing pending) and, before modifying the item, clearly stated the intended change and requested confirmation and a payment method. It looked up product variants, selected the easiest, least-piece option available (500 pieces, beginner), and updated the order using the specified PayPal method, with the correct refund amount reflected by the tool. No unsupported claims or unauthorized actions occurred. While the user profile address was not updated, the user only explicitly requested order address updates, so the agent met the user’s stated requests within policy.
